(Toledo, Ohio) | college = [[VCU Rams men's basketball|VCU]] (2018–2022) | draft_year = 2022 | draft_round = 2 | draft_pick = 47 | draft_team = [[Memphis Grizzlies]] | career_start = 2022 | years1 = {{nbay|2022|start}}–{{nbay|2025|end}} | team1 = [[Memphis Grizzlies]] | years2 = [[2022-23 NBA G League season|2022]]–[[2023-24 NBA G League season|2024]] | team2 = →[[Memphis Hustle]] | years3 = {{nbay|2025|end}} | team3 = [[Utah Jazz]] | highlights = * First-team All-[[Atlantic 10 Conference|Atlantic 10]] (2022) * Third-team All-Atlantic 10 (2021) }} '''Vincent Terrill Williams Jr.''' (born August 30, 2000) is an American professional [[basketball]] player who last played for the [[Utah Jazz]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[VCU Rams men's basketball|VCU Rams]]. ==College career== Before his freshman season at VCU, Williams tore his labrum in his left shoulder and was sidelined until August 2018.{{cite web|first=Corey|last=Crisan|title=Vince Williams at last healthy, excelling as part of VCU's starting lineup|url=https://www.toledoblade.com/sports/college/2020/12/19/toledo-st-john-graduate-vince-williams-healthy-excelling-at-vcu/stories/20201219014|work=[[The Blade (Toledo, Ohio)|The Blade]]|date=December 19, 2020|access-date=June 19, 2022}} As a freshman, he averaged 4.9 points and 3.3 rebounds per game.{{cite web|title=Vince Williams Jr. – 2021-22 – Men's Basketball|url=https://vcuathletics.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/vince-williams-jr-/4030|website=VCUAthletics.com|publisher=VCU Athletics|access-date=June 19, 2022}} During the offseason, he suffered a torn right labrum that required surgery and was not fully cleared to return until early October 2019.{{cite web|first=Wayne|last=Epps Jr.|title=Despite offseason hiccups, VCU's Vince Williams is still pushing toward his goal|url=https://richmond.com/sports/college/plus/despite-offseason-hiccups-vcus-vince-williams-is-still-pushing-toward-his-goal/article_c8decfda-75f7-54e3-905a-402c87dac7ee.html|work=[[Richmond Times-Dispatch]]|date=November 16, 2019|access-date=June 19, 2022}} Williams was limited to 21 games in his sophomore season due to hand and ankle injuries, averaging 4.2 points and 2.8 rebounds per game.{{cite web|first1=Kaitlyn|last1=Fulmore|first2=Ryan|last2=Grube|title=Meet the Team: men's basketball's young roster leads Rams into 2020-21 campaign|url=https://commonwealthtimes.org/2020/11/17/meet-the-team-mens-basketballs-young-roster-leads-rams-into-2020-21-campaign/|work=[[The Commonwealth Times]]|date=November 17, 2020|access-date=June 19, 2022}} ==Professional career== ===Memphis Grizzlies (2022–2026)=== Williams was selected with the 47th overall pick in the [[2022 NBA draft]] by the [[Memphis Grizzlies]]. On July 2, 2022, the Grizzlies signed him to a [[two-way contract]].{{cite web|title=Memphis Grizzlies sign Vince Williams Jr. and Kenneth Lofton Jr. to two-way contracts|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/memphis-grizzlies-sign-vince-williams-jr-and-kenneth-lofton-jr-to-two-way-contracts-220702|website=NBA.com|date=July 2, 2022|access-date=March 16, 2023}} Williams made 15 appearances (including one start) for Memphis during his rookie campaign, posting averages of 2.0 points, 1.0 rebound, and 0.3 assists.{{Cite web|title=Vince Williams Jr. 2022–23 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4397227/type/nba/year/2023|access-date=February 9, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} On January 10, 2024, Williams signed a multi-year contract with the Grizzlies.{{cite web|title=Memphis Grizzlies sign Vince Williams Jr. to multi-year contract|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/memphis-grizzlies-sign-vince-williams-jr-to-multi-year-contract|website=NBA.com|date=January 10, 2024|access-date=January 10, 2024}} He made 52 total appearances (including 33 starts) for Memphis during the [[2023–24 NBA season]], averaging 10.0 points, 5.6 rebounds, and 3.4 assists.{{Cite web|title=Vince Williams Jr. 2023–24 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4397227/type/nba/year/2024|access-date=February 9, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} Williams played in 27 games (including five starts) for the Grizzlies during the [[2024–25 NBA season]], averaging 6.6 points, 3.6 rebounds, and 2.0 assists.{{Cite web|title=Vince Williams Jr. 2024–25 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4397227/type/nba/year/2025|access-date=February 9, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} In the [[2025–26 NBA season]], Williams played in 34 games (including 12 starts) for the Grizzlies, posting averages of 8.0 points, 4.0 rebounds, and 4.4 assists.{{Cite web|title=Vince Williams Jr. 2025–26 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4397227/type/nba/year/2026|access-date=February 9, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} ===Utah Jazz (2026)=== On February 3, 2026, Williams, [[Jaren Jackson Jr.]], [[Jock Landale]], and [[John Konchar]] were traded to the [[Utah Jazz]] in exchange for [[Kyle Anderson (basketball)|Kyle Anderson]], [[Walter Clayton Jr.]], [[Taylor Hendricks]], [[Georges Niang]], and three first-round draft picks.{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/jazz/news/utah-jazz-acquire-former-nba-defensive-player-of-the-year-and-two-time-nba-all-star-jaren-jackson-jr|title=Utah Jazz Acquire Former NBA Defensive Player of the Year and Two-Time NBA All-Star Jaren Jackson Jr.|work=NBA.com|date=February 3, 2026}} On February 23, Williams suffered a season-ending left [[anterior cruciate ligament injury|ACL tear]] after colliding with [[2025–26 Houston Rockets season|Houston Rockets]] forward [[Tari Eason]] in an away-from-the-ball play.{{Cite web|title=Report: Jazz's Vince Williams Jr. suffers season-ending torn left ACL in collision with Rockets' Tari Eason|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/nba/breaking-news/article/report-jazzs-vince-williams-jr-suffers-season-ending-torn-left-acl-in-collision-with-rockets-tari-eason-182535632.html|access-date=March 16, 2026|website=sports.yahoo.com|language=en}} He had averaged 4.7 points, 3.2 rebounds, and 2.7 assists across six appearance for Utah prior the injury. On March 9, Williams was waived by the Jazz.https://www.nba.com/jazz/news/utah-jazz-waive-vince-williams-jr ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===NBA=== ====Regular season====
